name: workitem-grid-rules
description: Azure DevOps extension: smart grid control, conditional rules engine, dependent dropdowns and visual rule builder

scripts.package: npm run bump && npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path out
scripts.package:dev: npm run build:dev && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --overrides-file vss-extension.dev.json --output-path out
scripts.package:planner: node scripts/bump-version.js planner/vss-extension.json && npm run build:planner && tfx extension create --manifest-globs planner/vss-extension.json --output-path out
scripts.package:planner:dev: npm run build:planner:dev && tfx extension create --manifest-globs planner/vss-extension.json --overrides-file planner/vss-extension.dev.json --output-path out
scripts.package:all: npm run package && npm run package:planner
